predictions.articleTitle: Illueca vs Fraga Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Can Home Form Halt the Visitors?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Statistical goal modeling and defensive containment metrics favor Draw / Away Win alongside Under 2.5 goals in a tight 0:1 or 1:1 contest.

Under 2.5 goals aligns with the 2.36 combined lambda and 58.0% Poisson distribution below three goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
A 1:1 scoreline covers the 13.1% modal Poisson branch if Illueca's home attack breaches Fraga once (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)
